title: Pura Vida Solo: Surf, Jungle & Wellness: 6 days of waves, yoga, wildlife & candlelit jungle dining
description: A solo escape to Costa Rica's laid-back surf and yoga town. Ride world-class waves at Playa Guiones, witness sea turtles nesting at Ostional, dine in jungle canopy restaurants, and find your rhythm in the Nicoya Peninsula's blue zone energy.

days.title: Arrival & Playa Pelada Sunset
days.description: Touch down in the jungle, settle in, taste your first casado, and watch the sun melt into the Pacific from Nosara's most intimate beach.

activities.name: Arrive in Nosara
activities.description: Fly into Nosara Airport (NOB) or shuttle from Liberia (LIR, ~2.5 hrs). The tiny airstrip drops you right into the jungle. Arrange pickup through your hotel — roads here are unpaved and an adventure themselves.
details: ✈️ Sansa and Green Airways fly from San José (~35 min)
🚐 Private shuttles from Liberia run $50–80 per person
📱 Download offline maps — cell service is spotty

activities.name: Check in at Selina Nosara
activities.description: A solid solo-traveler base in Playa Guiones with coworking, pool, and surf rentals on site. Great for meeting other travelers. Private rooms are comfortable at ~$80/night. The common areas buzz with digital nomads and surfers.
details: 📍 Right on the main Guiones road, walkable to everything
🏊 Pool, coworking space, and board rentals on-site
💡 Solo tip: the communal dinners are the fastest way to make friends

activities.name: Explore Playa Pelada
activities.description: Walk the rocky coastline and tide pools of Playa Pelada. It's smaller and more intimate than Guiones — look for howler monkeys in the trees above the beach path. The blowhole rock formation at the north end is worth finding.
details: 🐒 Howler monkeys are most active in the trees around 4 PM
🪸 Tide pools are best explored at low tide
📸 The rocky headlands frame beautiful sunset shots

days.title: Surf Day at Playa Guiones
days.description: Paddle into one of Central America's best learning waves, refuel with fresh seafood, and chase the golden hour back into the lineup.

activities.name: Surf Lesson at Safari Surf School
activities.description: Playa Guiones is one of the best learning waves in Central America — long, consistent beach breaks that roll in like clockwork. Safari Surf is the OG school here with patient instructors. Book a 2-hour morning session when the tide is right.
details: 🏄 2-hour group lesson ~$65, private ~$95
🌊 Best at mid to high tide — instructors will guide timing
📏 They provide soft-top boards perfect for beginners

activities.name: Beach Time at Playa Guiones
activities.description: Grab a patch of sand on this long, wide beach. The surf breaks are mesmerizing to watch even from shore. Late April water temps hover around 82°F — no wetsuit needed. Watch for pelicans diving into the lineup.

activities.name: Sunset Surf Session
activities.description: Head back to Guiones for the golden hour session. Even if you wipe out all session, paddling out into a Nosara sunset is a core memory. The beach faces almost due west — pure magic.
details: 🌅 Sunset around 5:45 PM in late April
🏄 Board rental ~$15/half day from any shop on the main road

days.neighborhoods: Bodhi Tree · Nosara Biological Reserve · Jungle Highlands
days.title: Yoga, Jungle & Wellness
days.description: Flow through a morning yoga class, hike through mangrove forests alive with wildlife, then reward yourself with a spa treatment and the most unforgettable dinner in Nosara.

activities.name: Morning Yoga at Bodhi Tree Yoga Resort
activities.description: Nosara is the yoga capital of Costa Rica. Bodhi Tree offers drop-in classes in their stunning open-air shala surrounded by jungle. The 7:30 AM vinyasa flow is popular — arrive 10 minutes early.
details: 🧘 Drop-in class ~$20 · Mat provided
📍 Up the hill from Guiones — short drive or 15-min walk
💡 The juice bar post-class is excellent

activities.name: Nosara Biological Reserve Hike
activities.description: This private reserve protects mangroves and tropical dry forest along the Nosara River. Trails are well-marked and you'll likely spot iguanas, howler monkeys, and dozens of bird species. The canopy views of the river meeting the ocean are spectacular.
details: 🎟️ Entry ~$8 · Self-guided trails
🐒 Best wildlife spotting early morning or late afternoon
🌿 Bring water and bug spray — the mangrove trails are humid

activities.name: Spa Treatment at Onda Wellness
activities.description: Treat yourself to a massage or holistic treatment. Nosara's wellness scene is world-class. Onda offers everything from deep tissue to sound healing in a beautiful jungle setting. Solo travel pro-tip: this is the perfect mid-trip reset.
details: 💆 60-min massage ~$80–100
📍 Located between Guiones and Pelada

days.title: Sea Turtles & Beach Hopping
days.description: Drive north to one of the world's most important sea turtle nesting sites, then beach-hop south through fishing villages and end with the finest dinner in Nosara.

activities.name: Ostional National Wildlife Refuge
activities.description: One of the most important Olive Ridley sea turtle nesting sites in the world. Late April is nesting season — you may witness an arribada (mass nesting event where thousands of turtles come ashore simultaneously). Hire a local guide at the entrance who knows where the turtles are. The beach is wild and raw.
details: 🐢 Local guide ~$15 — mandatory for beach access during nesting
📍 45-min drive north of Nosara on rough roads
🌅 Best turtle activity at dawn and dusk
📸 No flash photography — follow guide instructions

activities.name: Playa Nosara & River Mouth
activities.description: On the way back, stop at Playa Nosara where the river meets the sea. This is a quieter, less touristy beach great for birdwatching. Crocodiles occasionally appear at the river mouth — keep a safe distance but it's thrilling to spot one.

activities.name: Playa Garza Visit
activities.description: A 15-minute drive south, this quiet fishing village beach is the antithesis of the Guiones scene. Watch local fishermen bring in their catch, wade in calm waters, and enjoy the solitude. A glimpse of old Costa Rica before the surf tourists arrived.

days.neighborhoods: Nosara Jungle · Playa Guiones · Gilded Iguana
days.title: Adventure Day — ATV, Waterfall & Final Surf
days.description: Your last full day — fill it with adrenaline. ATV through the jungle to hidden waterfalls, catch one more surf session, then celebrate with a farewell dinner and live music.

activities.name: ATV Tour to Hidden Waterfalls
activities.description: Book a half-day ATV tour through the Nosara jungle to remote waterfalls. You'll ford rivers, climb muddy trails, and swim in a jungle waterfall pool. The rainy season is just starting so the falls should be flowing nicely.
details: 🏍️ ~$75–90 per person · Several operators in Guiones
⏰ Tours typically depart 8:30 AM, return by noon
👟 Wear shoes you don't mind getting muddy

activities.name: Final Surf at Playa Guiones
activities.description: One last surf session. By now you should be popping up consistently on Guiones' forgiving waves. Rent a board from any shop on the main road. The afternoon glass-off around 3–4 PM often produces the cleanest waves of the day. Hike up to this viewpoint above Nosara for a panoramic sunset over the Pacific and jungle canopy. It's a short but steep climb — bring water. The 360-degree view is the best vantage point in the area.
details: 🏄 Board rental ~$15/half day
🌊 Check tide charts — mid-tide is usually best

activities.name: Live Music at Gilded Iguana
activities.description: The Gilded Iguana hotel bar is the social hub of Nosara. Check if they have live music tonight — it's common in season. Great spot to meet fellow travelers over a final Imperial beer and swap stories from the trip.
details: 🍺 Imperial is the local beer — order it like a local
🎶 Music usually starts around 8–9 PM

days.title: Final Morning & Departure
days.description: One last sunrise walk, a farewell açaí bowl, and a smoothie for the road. Nosara doesn't let go easily — you'll already be planning your return.

activities.name: Sunrise Walk on Playa Guiones
activities.description: Set your alarm early for one last beach walk. The sunrise paints the jungle-backed coastline in gold and pink. You'll likely have the beach nearly to yourself. Breathe in that salt air one last time.
details: 🌅 Sunrise ~5:25 AM in late April
🐾 Look for tracks in the sand — coatis and iguanas are early risers too

activities.name: Last-Minute Shopping
activities.description: Pick up souvenirs on the Guiones main road. Look for locally made jewelry, surf-inspired art, and Costa Rican coffee beans to take home. The small shops here support local artisans.

activities.name: Depart Nosara
activities.description: Head to Nosara Airport for your domestic flight, or begin the scenic drive back to Liberia. If driving, leave 3 hours for the unpaved roads. Pura vida — you'll be back.
details: ✈️ Confirm your flight the night before — small planes fill up
🚐 Hotel shuttles to Liberia typically depart 6–7 AM for international flights
